subject: Invest in Medford Campaign Kickoff
overview: City Council President Zac Bears spoke at a kickoff event for the Invest in Medford campaign advocating for ballot questions six, seven, and eight. He called on residents to donate and organize ahead of the November 5 election to fund local schools, roads, and fire facilities.

items.title: Invest in Medford campaign remarks
items.summary: Zac Bears urged attendees to organize and donate toward the campaign's $50,000 goal in support of ballot questions six, seven, and eight to address municipal underfunding in Medford's schools, streets, and fire headquarters.
